findings.title: session-end-extract shells out via execSync with string-interpolated sessionId/projectDir (quoting/injection fragility) and blocks SessionEnd up to 10s on a synchronous uv-python gate

findings.observe_how: A projectDir containing $(...) or backticks (or `&` on Windows cmd) is interpolated raw into the shell string.
